findings.title: Move-to-project authorization has no test
findings.problem: _validate_project_change was refactored to call the shared _require_project_access helper (User.has_access_to_application). The new tests cover only create_skill and import_skill; no test calls update_skill with a changed project, so inverting or dropping the check, or changing its help text, would pass the whole suite. Source read confirms behavior is equivalent today: maintainers already get is_admin=True in User.resolve_is_admin, and applications/applications_admin alias project_names/admin_project_names.
findings.impact: No behavior consequence today; the trigger is a future accidental regression of the move-path check on a security-relevant authorization, which nothing would catch.
findings.recommendation: Add tests for SkillService.update_skill (or _validate_project_change) with SkillUpdateRequest(project='project-b') for a non-member (403 PERMISSION_DENIED), a member and a project admin.

fix.change: Added mock-based tests pinning update_skill move-to-project authorization (non-member 403 with update-specific text, member, project admin, global admin)
